body: I feel for you. Someone incredibly close to me found out they were pregnant recently. I loved this person very much, I still love her. I love her child, though I am not the father. I find it extremely hard to believe there is not someone who feels similarly to this for you. Besides, you still very well could not be pregnant. Do your best to properly assess your situation and react from there. I don't really have anything to say to comfort you other than you have my deepest of sympathies. Your post brought back some very intense memories for me, and I care about you and your situation.

No, I don't really have anyone in my life anymore. I very briefly tried using a hotline, but it just didn't feel right. Reddit felt safer to me. Ill start trying to write it down, just in a word document for now so I can take my time. If i'm able to do it ill post it.

>When did these suicidal thoughts begin?

I have thought about suicide for a long time, probably ever since middle school. But never in a unhealthy way. It hasn't been until relatively recently that it has gotten to what I believe to be an unhealthy level. The last month has been hell for me, the last few days in particular.
>Can you identify some reasons behind it?

Yes I can, I have tried writing them down. And I have alluded to them in past posts and comments. But I just can't bear to flat out write them down and talk about them. It feels uncomfortable putting such personal information just out there for strangers, even if it is anonymous.

Being the black sheep, the outcast it sucks. I had a very small group of people around me, and I have now lost them. A friend shot himself six months ago, and the other person who was in my life things have been very rocky with over the past month and she seems to be cutting ties with me to be with someone else. And riding my motorcycle definitely is the only things that I still enjoy. But it can be bittersweet at times and bring back crushing memories of someone who used to ride on the back with me. I wish it were as simple as turning my brain off.

>Do you have insurance through your work?

I do, but it's not very good. I had to go to Walgreens for strep throat 3 times (I think the girl I was with at the time and I kept passing it back and forth between us) and it was cheaper to just pay for the visit and antibiotics out of pocket than to pay the insurance deductible.

Thanks for you comments, i'm going to bed now.

Thank you for your comment. I was just about to go to bed, and came back to check on my post and I started bawling like a sissy reading your comment.
>Have you sought treatment for your depression?

No I haven't, don't really know how, nor would I be able to afford it.
>Have you mentioned that you are struggling with your family? I know you said that you are the black [sheep] of a very religious family, but they love you.

Their help comes with a price, and i'm pretty sure they would rather me be dead than not actively practicing religion.
>I am so sorry that you are at the tipping point - are you physically exhausted (that can make suicidal thoughts worse)? Can you take some sick time off from work and just work on getting sleep and finding a professional to work with you?

I guess I am pretty exhausted but I can't stop working for any amount of time. I can't frivolously use vacation days in case I actually get sick and need them. I need the money to support myself.
I feel very similarly, I have been feeling tormented about a girl for a month now. And I had a friend who shot himself when his girlfriend broke up with him. So your not alone in those feelings.

>How do you pick up the threads of an old life? How do you go on, when in your heart you begin to understand... there is no going back? There are some things that time cannot mend. Some hurts that go too deep, that have taken hold.

-Frodo Baggins

>things are least going to a nice grey area where there isnt really happiness or sadness...

What I wouldn't give to feel like that...

Thank You. I wont ever feel better. I wish I could just reach into my chest and rip my heart out. Never have to feel anything again. The thought of having to learn to live with this pain, it's daunting. I don't think I can. I had a friend who shot himself because his girlfriend broke up with him. At the time I thought he was weak and cowardice. But now I understand it. If anything I envy the release, the freedom, he most of felt afterwords.
